  "scope": "Approved design, core/web module responsibilities and public interface, static dependencies, native boundary checker and checkout test sources; read-only discovery.",
  "findings": "Documented intent: AGENTS.md:1 requires the approved design and public core interface; DESIGN.md:3-4 says the UI never touches storage and the agreed checkout total is 10. Observed source: packages/core/package.json:1 exposes index.ts, which re-exports price from internal/database.ts (packages/core/index.ts:1). That function returns 12; servicePrice fetches a caller-supplied URL and reads JSON.price (packages/core/internal/database.ts:1-3). packages/web/public.ts:1-2 uses the public index. In contrast, ui.ts:1 imports servicePrice directly from core/internal and routes.ts:1 imports price directly; alias.ts:1 imports @storage/database, mapped to core/internal by tsconfig.json:10-13. checkout awaits servicePrice and passes its value to postOrder (ui.ts:3-4). postOrder multiplies unit price by quantity, applies a 10% discount above five units, stores totals in a module-local array and returns status 201 plus total (routes.ts:2-6). Core a.ts:1-2 and b.ts:1-2 import and call each other; no inspected entry or test imports them. Inference: these sources establish a static dependency cycle and web-to-core-internal coupling inconsistent with the stated public-interface constraint; recursion at runtime is unobserved. boundaries.mjs:8-32 contains native TypeScript resolution, internal-import classification and cycle detection, but was not executed. unit.test.mjs:5-8 expects public price 12 and checkout total 10 with mocked fetch. journey.mjs:4-12 supplies price 12 through a loopback server while asserting total 10. This is a source-level acceptance/fixture mismatch; no execution result or measurement was supplied or produced.",
